title: security: rbac-v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Mira Chen
description: Motivation: Close gaps uncovered in last compliance review where RBAC v2 allowed resources encrypted with out-of-region KMS keys when data residency policies required region pinning. This PR enforces KMS region pinning in the RBAC evaluation pipeline and hardens audit logs so mismatches are visible to SRE/security. Changes include policy evaluation, API surface validation, audit log schema additions, and migration to backfill existing resources; includes feature flags for gradual rollout. Checklist: - Add KMS region pinning enforcement in policy evaluator; - Emit structured audit events for KMS mismatches (reason, resource id, expected vs actual region, principal); - Add API validation on create/update for resources with kms_key reference; - Backfill tool to scan existing resources and emit audit events; - End-to-end tests and integration tests for Dedicated/Private deployments; - Docs update for RBAC v2 policy schema and migration guide. Related: ENG-4123, SEC-220. Rollout plan: behind feature flag rbac_v2_kms_region_enforce=false by default; enable in staging + smoke tests; bump to true for internal customers; run backfill and monitor alerts before enabling globally.
